name: MS-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district (R+18 PVI) with incumbent Trent Kelly running
Polymarket prices Kelly at 96% to win
No public polling; forecast rests on fundamentals and markets
Kelly outspent Johnson roughly two-to-one with far more cash on hand
model.rationale: Kelly is an incumbent in an R+18 district with a large cash advantage, and prediction markets price his win at 96%, so the forecast stays at the fundamentals-implied margin of about R+17.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing Johnson within single digits, or major outside spending against Kelly, would warrant moving this toward Likely R.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northern Mississippi's first district is solidly Republican ground, with a partisan lean of about R+18, and incumbent Trent Kelly is seeking another term after easily securing renomination. Kelly has raised just over $1 million and holds more than $860,000 on hand, while Democratic challenger Cliff Johnson has raised about $550,000 with under $150,000 available. No outside groups have reported spending in the race.

No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive. Prediction markets give Kelly roughly a 96% chance of winning. The forecast therefore expects a comfortable Republican win in the range of seventeen points, consistent with the district's fundamentals and the incumbent's financial edge.
